title: DEVOPS↔PO-001: Platform & Deployment Status + Deployment-Window Coordination
description: The DevOps/Platform Engineer provides platform and deployment status, deployment-pipeline health, OTA (Over-the-Air) delivery-infrastructure status, and reliability and cost reporting; the Product Owner/TPM provides release priorities and cadence, environment needs (staging, field-pilot, production), the infrastructure budget, approved deployment windows, and the acceptable risk tolerance. Grounded in DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.7. This contract coordinates deployment windows and reports OTA-infrastructure status only; OTA rollout strategy and governance remain in the MLOPS→DEVOPS→FW→BACK OTA chain and require an ADR for any strategy change.

platform_status_report.description: DEVOPS→PO: platform/deployment status, pipeline health, OTA-infra status, reliability and cost.

ota_delivery_infra_status.description: OTA delivery-infrastructure readiness (status only; OTA strategy stays in the OTA chain).

deployment_window_coordination.description: A proposed deployment against PO-approved windows; outside an approved window requires explicit PO exception approval.

po_platform_inputs.description: PO→DEVOPS: release priorities/cadence, environment needs, infrastructure budget, approved windows, risk tolerance.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine platform/deployment status reporting and deployment-window coordination is agent-autonomous (release planning; deployment-window coordination; reliability and cost reviews). A deployment outside an approved window needs PO exception approval; any OTA rollout-strategy change escalates to the OTA chain / ADR and is not decided here.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (release planning; per-release checkpoint; deployment-window coordination; reliability and cost reviews; ad hoc on infrastructure-blocking issues)
confirm_conditions: platform/deployment status and pipeline health are reported
reliability uptime carries its % unit; MTTR and cost figures carry explicit units
a deployment is confirmed within an approved window, or carries a PO exception-approval reference
OTA delivery-infra status is reported as status only (no strategy change embedded)
reject_conditions: a deployment scheduled outside an approved window without a PO exception-approval reference
a reliability, cost, or MTTR quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
an OTA rollout-strategy change decided within this contract without an ADR (OTA governance lives in the MLOPS→DEVOPS→FW→BACK chain)
counter_conditions: a requested deployment window conflicts with pipeline health (DEGRADED/DOWN) — request a window or risk-tolerance decision before scheduling
an infrastructure-budget constraint conflicts with the requested environment set — request a scope or budget decision
